metrics: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(is_open), 0) AS open, COALESCE(SUM(1 - is_open), 0) AS resolved, COALESCE(SUM(sla_state = 'Overdue'), 0) AS overdue, COALESCE(SUM(sla_state = 'At risk'), 0) AS at_risk, COALESCE(SUM(sla_state = 'Met'), 0) AS met, AVG(resolution_hours) AS avg_resolution_hours FROM tickets
by_department: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(is_open) AS open, SUM(sla_state = 'Overdue') AS overdue FROM tickets GROUP BY department ORDER BY total DESC, department
by_day: SELECT created_on, COUNT(*) AS total FROM tickets GROUP BY created_on ORDER BY created_on
